description: Get the node tree of the selection, page, or file (`scope`). The tool returns {fileName, scope, currentPage, nodes}. The tool stops at 500 nodes by default. It then sets `truncated`, and nodes with hidden children show `childCount`.

dedupe_components.description: Show instances in short form (mainComponentId, componentProperties, overrides) and list each component once in `componentDefs`. This saves tokens on screens with many instances.

depth.description: Levels below each root. 0 = root only. Default 2 for selection, no limit otherwise.

detail.description: minimal: id/name/type/bounds. compact: + fills/strokes/opacity. full (default): everything. Use lower levels for big files.

maxNodes.description: Max nodes (default 500). It does not apply with depth, a lower `detail`, or dedupe_components.

scope.description: page (default): current page. document: every page, one shared maxNodes limit. selection: selected nodes, 2 levels deep by default, or the page if the selection is empty. Use selection to explore.

name: get_document
